chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from al-Ḥasan ibn Ibrāhīm, from Yūnus, from Hishām ibn al-Ḥakam, concerning...

The hadith of Bureyh: when he came with him to Abū ʿAbdillāh (عليه السلام), he met Abū al-Ḥasan Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar (عليه السلام). Hishām related the account to him, and when he finished, Abū al-Ḥasan (عليه السلام) said to Bureyh: “O Bureyh, how is your knowledge of your Book?” He said, “I am knowledgeable of it.” Then he said, “How confident are you in its interpretation?” He said, “None is more confident than I am in my knowledge of it.”

He said: Then Abū al-Ḥasan (عليه السلام) began reciting the Injīl. Bureyh said, “You are the one I have been seeking for fifty years, or one like you.” He said: So Bureyh believed, and his faith became excellent, and the woman who was with him also believed. Then Hishām, Bureyh, and the woman entered upon Abū ʿAbdillāh (عليه السلام), and Hishām related to him the conversation that had occurred between Abū al-Ḥasan Mūsā (عليه السلام) and Bureyh.
So Abū ʿAbdillāh (عليه السلام) said: “Offspring, some of them from others, and Allah is Hearing, Knowing.”

Then Bureyh said, “How do you have the Tawrāh, the Injīl, and the books of the Prophets?” He said, “They are with us as an inheritance from them. We recite them as they recited them, and we speak them as they spoke them. Indeed, Allah does not place a ḥujjah in His earth who is asked about something and says: ‘I do not know.’”

key_terms.آمَنَ: he believed, indicating Bureyh’s acceptance of faith
key_terms.الْإِنْجِيلَ: the Evangel, recited here by the Imam as a sign of inherited scriptural knowledge
key_terms.تَأْوِيلِهِ: its interpretation, meaning the deeper understanding of the scripture
key_terms.حُجَّةً: a divine proof or authority established by Allah on earth
key_terms.ذُرِّيَّةً: offspring or lineage, expressing inherited continuity
key_terms.وِرَاثَةً: as inheritance, referring to the transmission of sacred knowledge from the Prophets

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe the Imams’ inherited knowledge of previous scriptures?
ai.summary: This narration describes Bureyh’s encounter with Imām Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar (عليه السلام), whose knowledge of the Injīl led Bureyh and the woman with him to faith. It emphasizes that the Ahl al-Bayt (عليهم السلام) inherit the revealed scriptures and possess authoritative knowledge, such that Allah’s ḥujjah on earth does not reply to questions with ignorance.
